// diagnostic E0778

Jet.RepeatableReachesNonRepeatable

`{fn_name}` is marked `#Repeatable`, but calls `{callee}`, which is not repeatable

What

`{fn_name}` is marked `#Repeatable`, but calls `{callee}`, which is not repeatable

Why

Calling a `#Repeatable` function twice must leave kept data the same as calling it once, so every non-read call it reaches must be `#Repeatable`, keyed with `#Repeatable(key: ...)`, or deferred with `app.enqueue`

Fix

Mark `{callee}` as `#Repeatable` when safe, supply a stable `#Repeatable(key: ...)` key, defer the call with `app.enqueue`, or remove `#Repeatable` from `{fn_name}`
